subject: app-rdef
title: APP.RDEF.------IST.S.ALGN.
description: Chart on book p. 289 (PR.S(RD)II-43). APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) is the subject; IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) is the partner. From the subject: IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis) and C-CONT (composite continuance). From IF-ST-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From INFO-DE-B: COS-DT. From CULT-INFO-BS: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From SOC-RT-P: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From C-CONT: TR-INFO (trans-information). From TR-INFO: RE-ST (restructuralism). From RE-ST: PRI-INFO (principle information).
